description:
[Results] Record the result of a candidate's external assessment step (status, score, pass / fail, report link). The step then waits for the recruiter's decision.

Records the result of an external assessment step of an application (status, score, pass / fail, report link). A result never decides on its own: the step then waits for the recruiter to pass or fail it. Requires the token of a merchant or merchant owner of the company; available when external assessments are enabled for the company.

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

passed.description: Pass / fail as the assessment reports it. Without it the step's pass mark decides it from the score.

position_result_step_id.description: The external assessment step of the application (position_result_step id).

result_label.description: Result label, for example a language level.

status.description: started, completed (a result), expired (not taken in time) or cancelled.

name: set_assessment_result

outputSchema.description: The recorded result. The step now waits for the recruiter's decision.

outcome.description: applied, or ignored_final for a cancelled assessment.

status.description: Status of the assessment after the call.

title: Record an external assessment result
